paragraph: From a small creative studio to a full-stack MarTech & Creative Technology company. Scroll to explore our journey.

timeline.title: Founded
timeline.body: Turned away project-based work from day one and bet the entire business on retainers built around outcomes, not deliverables. It was the harder sell in year one — and the only model that scaled.

timeline.title: First Category Leader
timeline.body: Landed the first recognizable market leader as a client, not through a pitch deck, but through a competitor's referral. That single account became the case study that opened every door after it.
stats: Inbound referrals received: 60% of new business
Avg. deal size vs. prior year: +4x

timeline.title: Certified Partner Status
timeline.body: Became an official Premier Partner across major ad platforms, earning direct access to beta tools and priority support most agencies wait years for. Clients got platform-level advantages before their competitors even knew they existed.

timeline.title: Research Practice Launched
timeline.body: Stopped treating research as a one-off onboarding exercise and built it into a standing practice, continuous consumer and competitor tracking for every active account. Strategy stopped starting from assumptions.
stats: Strategy revisions triggered by research: 65% of accounts

timeline.title: First Industry Award
timeline.body: Won national recognition for a campaign built entirely in-house, validating a systems-first approach the industry had mostly dismissed as "too clinical" to be creative. Turns out disciplined and distinctive weren't opposites.

timeline.title: ORM Practice Born
timeline.body: When online conversations turned volatile overnight, reputation management stopped being a side service and became a dedicated practice with its own team and workflows. What started as crisis response became a permanent capability.
stats: Avg. response time to flagged mentions: <2 hrs

timeline.title: Talent Academy Launched
timeline.body: Built a structured internal training program instead of relying on the market to supply ready-made talent — because the systems-first approach only works if every hire thinks that way from day one. Attrition dropped as fast as skill levels rose.

timeline.title: First Global Client
timeline.body: Signed the first client headquartered outside India, proving the systems-first model traveled beyond the market it was built for. Domestic case studies stopped being the only proof point in the pitch.

timeline.title: Sentinel Goes Live
timeline.body: Launched Sentinel, an AI-native engine that reads sentiment, press coverage, and crisis signals across the internet in real time — turning reputation management from a monthly report into a live, always-on system.

timeline.title: Full-Stack Integration
timeline.body: MarTech, creative, and performance stopped being three connected services and became one operating system — a single dashboard replacing what used to take five separate tools and three separate teams to track. The stack officially became the product.

timeline.title: Today
timeline.body: A decade of contrarian bets, retainers over projects, research as infrastructure, AI as craft rather than shortcut, compounded into a full-stack MarTech and creative technology system running for over a hundred brands worldwide. Not an agency renting tools anymore, a growth partner that builds and owns its own stack.

endCard.heading: The Next Chapter Starts With You.
